It also doesn't give quantitative data - no AUC, fold-change, or sample size. The study only used one pair of envelopes from one macaque. Since biomarker studies need clear glycan features and performance metrics, this seems insufficient. The abstract says "our data suggested" without concrete evidence - definitely needs full text to confirm the glycan's role as a biomarker.

Study type: It's a single animal model study with site-directed mutagenesis - that's experimental research, so "others" category. Not case-control or cohort since it's not human observational data.
